Understanding prayer times in London

London uses the Muslim World League method and Europe/London time. Long summer twilight at this latitude can lead to differences in Fajr and Isha between calculation methods and local timetables. The existing engine applies its high-latitude rule, so checking your mosque timetable remains important. Clock times automatically follow winter and summer time.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
